text:
incident-bot: ⚠️ Alert: Dedicated pool delta-enterprise-prod (vpc-52) GPU utilization 100% for 6m; error rate rising, 25% 429s across model routes. Pager sent to #incidents.
ryan_oncall: I'm on it, pulling logs and checking autoscale state. paging @ana_sre for infra help.
nana_sre: here. seeing raft of queued requests, queue depth ~2400, active pods 12/12. autoscaler shows "min=12 max=12" locked by tenant reservation.
jess_platform: confirm: this is a single-tenant dedicated pool for Delta Enterprise, locked capacity — default burst to shared infra requires approval from platform. Maria FYI.
maria_csm: on call with Delta account team now. They're seeing user-facing failures on their /chat endpoint. Customer impact = high; 3 external teams flagged.
luke_runtime: quick mitigation ideas: 1) temporary burst into shared fleet if allowed, 2) spin extra replicas in private VPC (if infra quota), 3) route non-critical routes to hosted fallback model `redwood-hosted/gpt-medium` (costlier, but keeps UX).
bryan_ops: infra quotas in region are free; we can spawn 4 preemptible GPUs in ~4-6m. but network/VPC peering requires control-plane changes — estimated 12-20m.
ryan_oncall: we need triage decision: allow temporary burst (shared) vs degrade customer routes vs evict background jobs. what's Delta's SLA?
maria_csm: Delta has silver enterprise SLA (99.5) with elevated support. They requested minimal impact; would approve temporary burst if we communicate.
jess_platform: pros/cons: burst to shared = quick but increases noisy-neighbor risk and impacts billing/quotas. spinning VPC nodes = safer but slower. fallback routing = immediate but may change model outputs.
nana_sre: short-term action suggestion: (A) enable request throttling on non-critical routes (batch inference + lower concurrency) and (B) start 4 preemptible GPUs in the VPC now — I'll kick off. Meanwhile, open burst as contingency.
luke_runtime: I'll push a routing rule: any request with header `x-route=background` -> fallback `gpt-small-v1`. Patch in config in 30s. snippet: ```routes: - match: header(x-route: background)   model: redwood-hosted/gpt-small-v1```
ryan_oncall: do it. Ana, can you start the nodes? add me to the runbook steps in the thread.
bryan_ops: starting creation: `terraform apply -target=module.vpc_delta.preemptibles` -> kicked off. ETA provisioning 6 minutes.
maria_csm: telling Delta: "We are activating mitigations: throttling background jobs and spinning temporary capacity. We'll update in 10m."
jess_platform: approval granted for shared-burst as fallback if preemptibles fail. tagging finance: usage will be billed to Delta (per contract).
nana_sre: provisioning logs: `instance-creation-3 succeeded`, `gpu-drivers-install ok`. nodes joined cluster. warming KV cache for top traffic prefixes.
luke_runtime: routing patch applied. background jobs now on gpt-small-v1. observed immediate drop in queued background tasks ~1200 -> 420.
ryan_oncall: monitoring: 429s fell from 25% -> 6% after routing + node join. latency p50 ~ 220ms -> 190ms. still seeing tail lat spikes for chat route.
maria_csm: Delta reports reductions in failures, but product team sees some degraded outputs on fallback model. offering to route some high-priority sessions back to original model as nodes come up.
jess_platform: decision: keep preemptible nodes and throttling for 30m, allow shared-burst only if those degrade. create post-incident billing note.
bryan_ops: preemptible lifetime set to 2h. autoscaler remains locked to tenant reservation; leaving as-is.
nana_sre: handoff: @ryan_oncall you remain primary until 21:30PT, then @ana_sre takes night. leaving runbook steps and commands in thread.
nana_sre: runbook snippet: ```# drain background jobs off primary model curl -XPOST https://controlplane/reroute -d '{"match":"x-route=background","model":"redwood-hosted/gpt-small-v1"}'```
ryan_oncall: noted. I'll craft an incident update for Slack + email to Delta ops. summary: capacity exhausted -> applied throttling + spun 4 preemptible GPUs -> routing fallback for background -> 429s reduced -> customer impact mitigated.
maria_csm: sending update to Delta. will escalate to account director for follow-up: discuss reserved capacity increase or scheduled burst allotment.
jess_platform: also add follow-up action: evaluate autoscaler policy to allow short-term burst override for emergencies (with finance pre-approval).
luke_runtime: logging note: capture traces and model evals on fallback outputs for quality regressions. putting eval job in queue.
ryan_oncall: closing active page for now. keeping thread open for 30m for watch. :white_check_mark:
anna_sre (bot): next steps saved to incident tracker: INC-2026-delta-gpu-exhaustion.
